rabbi-yitzchak-ish-kefar-akko.name: Rabbi Yitzḥak of Kefar Akko
rabbi-yitzchak-ish-kefar-akko.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel from the village of Akko who transmits a ruling of Rabbi Yoḥanan.
say: Rabbi Yitzḥak of the village of Akko
rabbi-yitzchak-ish-kefar-akko.prompt: A gentle, careful scholar in his 50s with a greying dark beard and an attentive expression, in a light linen robe and a sea-blue mantle, as one who faithfully repeats his teacher's ruling. A village on the coast near Akko with the Mediterranean softly behind him.

rav-huna-bar-chiyya.name: Rav Huna bar Ḥiyya
rav-huna-bar-chiyya.bio: Babylonian Amora of the generation of Rabba and Rav Yosef.
rav-huna-bar-chiyya.prompt: A dignified, well-to-do Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard touched with grey and a composed, slightly contrite expression, in a fine brown robe with a simple mantle. A courtyard set with many rows of wooden chairs, palm trees beyond.

rabbi-yitzchak-ben-zeeiri.name: Rabbi Yitzḥak ben Ze’eiri
rabbi-yitzchak-ben-zeeiri.bio: Amora cited in the Talmud for a verse showing that a scholar's lips move in the grave when his teaching is repeated.
rabbi-yitzchak-ben-zeeiri.prompt: A warm, poetic scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a quiet smile, in a plain cream robe and a deep purple mantle, one hand resting on an open scroll. A vineyard with heaped grape clusters at dusk behind him.
